name: label-studio
description_en: Label Studio is a multi-type data labeling and annotation tool with standardized output format
readme_excerpt: Website • Docs • Join Slack Community What is Label Studio? Label Studio is an open source data labeling tool. It lets you label data types like audio, text, images, videos, and time series with a simple and straightforward UI and export to various model formats.
